title: B1 Single-Reference Visual Analysis
description: Structured description of exactly one user-owned game visual or art reference. The result records evidence, visual language, candidates for later B2 comparison, content-specific traits, and uncertainty without giving UI design recommendations or declaring an overall game style.

schema_version.description: Protocol version. Version 0.2 adds the formal B1 visual-analysis structures; 0.1 remains an accepted legacy identifier.

input_kind.description: Compatibility discriminator. single_asset retains the legacy meaning; single_reference identifies one complete B1 visual/art reference.

asset_id.description: Stable identifier for this single-reference analysis, using snake_case or kebab-case.

source_ref.description: Stable reference to the supplied image source, such as an attachment ID or workspace-relative path.

file_name.description: File name of the analyzed reference.

file_path.description: Optional workspace path retained for backward compatibility.

source_hint.description: Optional user-provided description or usage hint. Treat it as user_provided information, never as observed evidence.

page_context.description: Legacy page or scene context. Retained unchanged as compatibility information and not used to prescribe a page layout.

reference_kind.description: What the complete reference image is. This is distinct from asset_category and user_intended_use.

asset_category.description: Category of the main asset or subject. Legacy values are preserved and broader B1 subject categories are added.

visual_identity.description: Concise identity of what is visibly depicted in this image.

intended_role.description: Optional caller-provided project role retained from the legacy contract. New B1 analysis must not infer or generate this field.

role_candidates.description: Legacy compatibility field for previously recorded role candidates. New B1 analysis does not generate this field.

visual_description.description: Natural-language description limited to what the current image visibly presents, including subject, composition, and salient appearance. Do not include UI or generation recommendations.

visual_language.description: Comparable description of the six visual-language dimensions observed in this image.

world_visual_context.description: Theme or world cues supported by this image. These are image-scoped inferences, not confirmed settings for the whole game.

style_candidates.description: Image-scoped color, material, shape, rendering, lighting, decoration, or world/theme visual traits for future B2 verification. Do not include composition, camera angle, perspective layout, subject placement, page layout, or element positions. Candidates are not final overall-game style decisions.

content_specific_traits.description: Traits tied to this image's particular subject, scene, composition, object, or event. B2 must not automatically promote them to global style traits.

evidence.description: Source-labeled statements that distinguish observed evidence, model inference, and user-provided information.

user_intended_use.description: Optional caller/user-provided intended use. Preserve it only when explicitly supplied; never infer it from reference_kind, asset_category, or visible content. Omit the field or use null when no intended use was provided.

uncertainties.description: Material ambiguities or unsupported judgments that should remain unresolved rather than guessed.

reason.description: Why the image or supplied context does not support a reliable conclusion.

technical_metadata.description: Optional objective file metadata retained for backward compatibility.

format.description: File format such as png or jpg.

layout_behavior.description: Optional legacy engineering compatibility information. New B1 visual analysis does not generate this field; preserve it only when reading or carrying forward legacy data.

stretchable.description: Legacy indication of whether the asset may tolerate stretching in its known role.

nine_slice_candidate.description: Legacy indication of possible nine-slice treatment; not an actual slicing result.

safe_overlay_note.description: Legacy note about relatively unobstructed or sensitive regions.

protected_region_note.description: Legacy note about visual regions that should remain visible.

laya_new_ui.description: Optional legacy Laya compatibility information. New B1 visual analysis does not generate this field; preserve it only when reading or carrying forward legacy data.

size_grid_candidate.description: Legacy nine-slice candidate. It may be null, manual_required, or a four-integer candidate string.

usage_note.description: Legacy Laya usage note retained for compatibility.

confidence.description: Overall confidence in this single-image B1 analysis.

notes.description: Concise supplementary notes. Do not use notes for UI recommendations or unsupported style conclusions.

evidence_statement.description: One claim labeled by its information source.

source.description: Whether the statement is directly visible, model-inferred, or supplied by the user.

trait.description: Concise, comparable visual trait scoped to this image.

color_language.description: Observed color relationships rather than isolated color names or invented exact values.

material_language.description: Tangible materials and visible surface qualities supported by the image. Atmospheric effects, light effects, fire, smoke, fog, glow, and particles are not materials.

name.description: Observed or cautiously inferred material name.

shape_language.description: Dominant silhouette, contour, symmetry, and geometric tendencies.

description.description: Concise account of how the selected shape traits appear.

rendering_language.description: How the image is rendered, kept distinct from its theme.

primary_style.description: Primary rendering approach visible in this image.

lighting_language.description: Observed illumination, exposure, highlights, shadows, emissive effects, and atmosphere.

ambient_character.description: Concise description of ambient light character.

dominant_direction.description: Dominant light direction when observable; null when it cannot be reliably determined.

presence.description: Observed presence state without forcing a guess.

decoration_language.description: Visible ornamental motifs and their density, organization, scale, and restraint.
